about: The layout department's sheet for THE REPUBLIC: for every episode, the places its planes are cut from (each searched in the archive, then split by depth into far, middle and near planes), who is in it (each searched as a figure and cut out by depth), the one thing it needs on a plane of its own, and the grade the whole stack is printed through. Voices are Kokoro-82M voices; robots are spoken through a light metal filter. No voice imitates a real person.
